**证据（nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps）：**
```
PID 2234  → GPU-c04f6d12 (GPU 0), 17532 MiB  ← eval_math500_grpo_standard_20_fair_2048_v2
```

```python
if "CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES" not in os.environ and "--gpu" in sys.argv:
```
